capabilities: Convert Markdown checkboxes inside tables into HTML checkboxes
Toggle checkboxes in reading view and save state to the file
Bulk-convert all checkboxes in the current file via a command
Regenerate all checkbox IDs via a command
problem: Obsidian does not render interactive, stateful checkboxes inside Markdown tables, so tasks listed in a table cannot be checked.
summary: Renders Markdown checkboxes inside tables as clickable HTML checkboxes whose state is saved back to the file.
